dayActivities.title: Drive from Abu Road to Jodhpur, culminating in a Jawai Wildlife Safari through rugged landscapes
dayActivities.description: Travel from Abu Road to Jodhpur, followed by curated visits to Jawai Wildlife Safari.
activities: Arrival in Abu Road & Hotel Check-in
Transfer from Abu Road to Jodhpur  (Inter-city Scenic Drive)
timeline: Arrival at Abu Road Airport / Railway Station, meet our tour representative, and transfer to your hotel.
Complete smooth hotel check-in formalities and refresh at Kuchaman Haveli, Jodhpur.
**Jawai Wildlife Safari**: Explore Jawai’s rugged landscape and spot leopards, crocodiles and diverse wildlife.
Enjoy dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at Kuchaman Haveli, Jodhpur.

dayActivities.title: Journey from Jodhpur to Jaisalmer, exploring Mehrangarh Fort, Umaid Bhavan Palace, guided Blue City tour, and Jaswant Thada
dayActivities.description: Travel from Jodhpur to Jaisalmer, followed by curated visits to Mehrangarh Fort & Museum, Umaid Bhavan Palace Museum & Vintage Car Collection, Guided Blue City Tour & Food Tour and Jaswant Thada.
activities: Transfer from Jodhpur to Jaisalmer  (Approx. 285 KM | 4.5 - 5 Hrs Drive)
Umaid Bhavan Palace Museum & Vintage Car Collection
Guided Blue City Tour & Food Tour
timeline: Enjoy a wholesome breakfast and complete check-out formalities in Jodhpur.
Depart from Jodhpur and proceed on a scenic drive towards Jaisalmer  (Approx. 285 KM | 4.5 - 5 Hrs Drive).
Arrive in Jaisalmer and complete check-in formalities at Antra Inn, Jaisalmer.
**Mehrangarh Fort & Museum**: Explore the magnificent Mehrangarh Fort, royal palaces, museum & Enjoy the Mehrangarh Fort Zipline & also enjoy the Rao Jodha Desert Park (Optional).
**Umaid Bhavan Palace Museum & Vintage Car Collection**: Discover royal artefacts, vintage automobiles and Jodhpur’s royal heritage.

**Guided Blue City Tour & Food Tour**: Explore Jodhpur’s Blue City on a guided walking and food tour, discovering vibrant blue streets, hidden gems, and local culture. Savour iconic local treats, including Shahi Samosa near Clock Tower, Mirchi Bada at Manak Chowk, and Moti Jalebi at Tripoliya Bazaar for an authentic taste of Jodhpur.
**Jaswant Thada**: Beautiful white-marble royal memorial with peaceful surroundings and city views.
Enjoy dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at Antra Inn, Jaisalmer.

dayActivities.title: Travel from Jaisalmer to the desert camp, visiting Jaisalmer Fort, Patwon Ki Haveli, Bada Bagh, and sunset camel safari at Sam Dunes
dayActivities.description: Travel from Jaisalmer to Jaisalmer Dessert, followed by curated visits to Jaisalmer Fort, Patwon Ki Haveli & Museum, Bada Bagh and Sam Dunes.
activities: Transfer from Jaisalmer to Jaisalmer Dessert  (Inter-city Scenic Drive)
timeline: Enjoy a wholesome breakfast and complete check-out formalities in Jaisalmer.
Depart from Jaisalmer and proceed on a scenic drive towards Jaisalmer Dessert  (Inter-city Scenic Drive).
Arrive in Jaisalmer Dessert and complete check-in formalities at Kk Groups Camp, Jaisalmer Dessert.
**Jaisalmer Fort**: Explore the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort, showcasing golden sandstone architecture and rich heritage.
**Patwon Ki Haveli & Museum**: Explore Patwon Ki Haveli, showcasing intricate architecture, heritage and traditional craftsmanship.
**Bada Bagh**: Explore Bada Bagh’s magnificent royal cenotaphs and historic sandstone architecture.
**Sam Dunes**: Experience the Sam Dunes with stunning sunsets, desert camel safaris, cultural activities and camping.
Enjoy dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at Kk Groups Camp, Jaisalmer Dessert.

dayActivities.title: Drive from Jaisalmer Desert to Bikaner, discovering Karni Mata Temple, Bada Bazaar, Bikaneri Food Trail, and Khari Bazaar
dayActivities.description: Travel from Jaisalmer Dessert to Bikaner, followed by curated visits to Karni Mata Temple, Bada Bazaar, Bikaneri Food Trail and Khari Bazaar.
activities: Transfer from Jaisalmer Dessert to Bikaner  (Approx. 330 KM | 5.5 - 6 Hrs Drive)
timeline: Enjoy a wholesome breakfast and complete check-out formalities in Jaisalmer Dessert.
Depart from Jaisalmer Dessert and proceed on a scenic drive towards Bikaner  (Approx. 330 KM | 5.5 - 6 Hrs Drive).
Arrive in Bikaner and complete check-in formalities at Hotel Sagar Niwas, Bikaner.
**Karni Mata Temple**: Famous as the Rat Temple, this unique shrine is home to thousands of sacred rats worshipped by devotees.
**Bada Bazaar**: A lively traditional market offering Rajasthani textiles, handicrafts, jewellery, footwear and local specialities.
**Bikaneri Food Trail**: Taste the city's famous bhujia, rasgullas, kachori, sweets and authentic Rajasthani delicacies.
**Khari Bazaar**: Explore traditional local shops, regional snacks, Bikaneri sweets and authentic old-city market life.
Enjoy dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at Hotel Sagar Niwas, Bikaner.

dayActivities.title: Journey from Bikaner to Jaipur, touring Junagarh Fort, Prachina Museum, Lalgarh Palace, and Johari Bazaar
dayActivities.description: Travel from Bikaner to Jaipur, followed by curated visits to Junagarh Fort, Prachina Musuem, Lalgarh Palace and Johari Bazaar.
activities: Transfer from Bikaner to Jaipur  (Approx. 330 KM | 5.5 - 6 Hrs Drive)
timeline: Enjoy a wholesome breakfast and complete check-out formalities in Bikaner.
Depart from Bikaner and proceed on a scenic drive towards Jaipur  (Approx. 330 KM | 5.5 - 6 Hrs Drive).
Arrive in Jaipur and complete check-in formalities at Hotel Magenta, Jaipur.

**Junagarh Fort**: One of Rajasthan's most magnificent forts, known for its grand courtyards, ornate balconies, beautiful palaces and impressive Rajput architecture. Inside Visit Sheesh Mahal , Anup Mahal , Chand Mahal.
**Prachina Musuem**: A heritage museum showcasing royal costumes, jewellery, textiles, paintings and traditional artefacts.
**Lalgarh Palace**: A beautiful red sandstone palace blending Rajput, Mughal and European architectural styles.
**Johari Bazaar**: Explore Jaipur’s vibrant Johari Bazaar, known for traditional jewellery, handicrafts, textiles and colourful local shopping and authentic.
Enjoy dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at Hotel Magenta, Jaipur.

dayActivities.title: Explore Jaipur’s iconic landmarks: Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort, Lalgarh Palace, and enjoy sunset dining at Nahargarh Fort
dayActivities.description: Explore Jaipur with curated visits to Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort, Lalgarh Palace and Nahargarh Fort With RTDC Durg Cafeteria Nahargarh Fort Sunset Dining Experience.
activities: Nahargarh Fort With RTDC Durg Cafeteria Nahargarh Fort Sunset Dining Experience
timeline: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before proceeding for the day's curated sightseeing in Jaipur.
**Hawa Mahal**: Visit the iconic Hawa Mahal and admire its stunning pink façade, intricate windows and unique Rajput-era architecture.
**Amber Fort**: Explore the magnificent Amber Fort and admire its grand palaces, courtyards, intricate architecture and rich Rajput heritage.
**Lalgarh Palace**: A beautiful red sandstone palace blending Rajput, Mughal and European architectural styles.

**Nahargarh Fort With RTDC Durg Cafeteria Nahargarh Fort Sunset Dining Experience**: Enjoy a spectacular sunset at Nahargarh Fort with a memorable dining experience at RTDC Durg Cafeteria, overlooking Jaipur’s beautiful cityscape.
Enjoy dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at Hotel Magenta, Jaipur.

dayActivities.title: Morning leisure in Jaipur followed by airport transfer
dayActivities.description: Enjoy breakfast before completing check-out and transferring for your departure journey.
timeline: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before proceeding for the day's curated sightseeing in Jaipur.
Transfer to Jaipur Airport / Railway Station for your onward journey home with wonderful memories.
